source:
A rude and cranky clerk working at the convenience store Fresh Marke which [url=/c87342]Haruaki[/url] visits on the way to Kamifujiyoshi.

[spoiler]Her name is Mitsuji Misamine and she was the ex-girlfriend whom Haruaki was trying to run away from. 

She is a dreamweaver like [url=/c87369]Rikako[/url], and she appears in the form of a floating goat when helping Haruaki within Rikako's looping dream and is also the same goat the reader encounters upon reading through bad endings. She's often called by the nickname Sheep (Hitsuji).


Survivor of the Salvation Pasture Project.[/spoiler]
